energy_definition: conceptual E(n)=log log n; odd +log(3/2), even -log 2
exact_surrogate: T^k(n)<n for block contraction; T(n)^2<=n^3 (odd) and T(n)^2<=n (even) for one-step increments. No floating-point verdicts.

candidate_statements.name: one_step_increment_bounds
candidate_statements.exact_statement: For odd n>=3, T(n)^2 <= n^3 and T(n)>n. For even n>=2, T(n)^2 <= n and T(n)<n. These are the exact power surrogates of the additive log-log increments.
candidate_statements.motivation: Ask whether fixed additive branch costs exist as exact inequalities. The power bounds are the floor-power definitions; the signs are the one-step expansion/contraction of the exact surrogate T.
candidate_statements.expected_yield: formalizable branch costs, or a definitional restatement
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen n in the domain violating a power bound or T-sign
candidate_statements.failure_mechanism: survived, but the inequality is the floor-power definition or even-branch contraction already implied by T(n)<n. Not new compositional loot.

candidate_statements.name: oooee_conditional_contraction
candidate_statements.exact_statement: If a trajectory follows the parity word OOOEE starting at n>=2, then T^5(n)<n. Conditional on the branch word; not a claim that every orbit contains OOOEE.
candidate_statements.motivation: OOOEE is the first mixed block whose idealized drift is negative: 3^3=27 < 2^5=32. Exact surrogate T^5(n)<n.
candidate_statements.relevant_domain: n>=2 whose five successive branch parities are OOOEE
candidate_statements.expected_yield: conditional five-step contraction, or a floor counterexample
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen OOOEE seed with T^5(n)>=n

candidate_statements.name: shortest_negative_block
candidate_statements.exact_statement: If a trajectory follows the parity word EE starting at n>=2, then T^2(n)<n. Selected as the shortest frozen-list word with exact negative idealized drift and depth<=5.
candidate_statements.motivation: Among EE, OEE, OOOE, OOOEE, OOOEEE, the shortest negative-drift word of depth<=5 is EE. Do not optimize over arbitrary words.
candidate_statements.relevant_domain: n>=2 whose successive branch parities are EE
candidate_statements.expected_yield: a short contractive block, or a restatement of even contraction
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen EE seed with T^2(n)>=n
candidate_statements.failure_mechanism: survived, but the inequality is the floor-power definition or even-branch contraction already implied by T(n)<n. Not new compositional loot.
